'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Kyiv strikes (2022–present)|Kyiv strikes]]
***[[Russian Armed Forces|Russian forces]] launch their largest air attack on [[Ukraine]], including the capital city [[Kyiv]], since the start of the war, killing at least 14 people and wounding dozens more. At least 298 [[Iran]]ian [[Shahed drones]] and 69 [[missile]]s are launched at Ukrainian cities during the overnight attack. [https://www.reuters.com/business/aerospace-defense/russian-drone-fragments-set-kyiv-apartment-building-ablaze-official-says-2025-05-24/ (Reuters)] [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cx2rx8kxdm4o (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Ten people are killed, including [[Humboldt University]] students and professors, and eleven others are injured in a car accident near [[Armenia, Colombia|Armenia]], [[Colombia]], when a bus loses control and crashes into a barrier. [https://www.cbsnews.com/chicago/video/10-killed-11-others-hurt-in-bus-crash-in-columbia/ (WBBM-TV)] [https://www.dailysabah.com/world/americas/bus-crash-during-colombia-uni-field-trip-kills-at-least-10 (''Daily Sabah'')]
*Five people are found dead near the [[ski resort]] of [[Zermatt]] in [[Valais]], [[Switzerland]], following an [[avalanche]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/five-skiers-found-dead-southwest-switzerland-2025-05-25/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*At least four people are injured, including one seriously, in a [[mass stabbing]] attack with a [[machete]] and fight between gangs at the [[Northland Shopping Centre]] in [[Melbourne]], [[Victoria (state)|Victoria]], [[Australia]]. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2025-05-25/northland-shopping-centre-knives-attack-preston-police-update/105334604 (ABC News Australia)]

'''Politics and elections''' 
*[[2025 Surinamese general election]]
**Citizens of [[Suriname]] vote to elect 51 seats of the [[National Assembly (Suriname)|National Assembly]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20250525-suriname-votes-for-new-government-to-steer-oil-windfall (''France 24'')]
*[[2025 Venezuelan parliamentary election]]
**[[Elections in Venezuela|Parliamentary elections]] in [[Venezuela]] are held amidst heightened government repression and opposition boycott. [https://apnews.com/article/venezuela-maduro-regional-election-machado-boycott-repression-2b994304869b9d89740b3ba59023d94a (AP)]
**The [[Venezuelan government]] holds an election for the [[Essequibo region (disputed territory)|Essequibo region]] of [[Guyana]], which [[Venezuela]] [[Guyana–Venezuela territorial dispute|claims]] as part of its territory. In response, [[Guyana Defence Force|Guyana military]] chief [[Omar Khan (military)|Omar Khan]] visits [[Guyana–Venezuela border|border towns]] to reinforce its military presence. [https://www.nytimes.com/2025/05/25/world/americas/venezuela-election-essequibo-guyana.html (''The New York Times'')] [https://www.stabroeknews.com/2025/05/25/news/guyana/gdf-cds-in-reinforcement-visit-to-kaikan/ (''Stabroek News'')]

'''Sports'''
*[[2024–25 EuroLeague]]
**In basketball, the [[EuroLeague]] concludes with [[Fenerbahçe S.K. (basketball)|Fenerbahçe]] beating [[Monaco Basket|Monaco]] 81–70 in the [[EuroLeague Final Four|Final Four Playoff]] championship game. [[Nigel Hayes-Davis]] is awarded [[EuroLeague Final Four MVP|MVP]]. [https://www.dailysabah.com/sports/basketball/fenerbahce-beat-monaco-to-clinch-turkish-airlines-euroleague-crown/amp (''Daily Sabah'')]
*[[2025 Indianapolis 500]]
**In [[auto racing]], three-time [[Indycar]] champion [[Álex Palou]] of [[Spain]] wins the 109th [[Indianapolis 500]], giving [[Chip Ganassi Racing]] its sixth victory in the event. [https://www.foxnews.com/sports/alex-palou-wins-2025-indianapolis-500 (Fox News)]
*[[2025 Monaco Grand Prix]]
**In [[Formula 1]], British driver [[Lando Norris]] wins the [[Monaco Grand Prix]] for [[McLaren]]. It is McLaren's first victory at the event since 2008. [https://www.motorsport.com/f1/news/f1-monaco-gp-lando-norris-masters-tactical-race-to-win/10726579/ (Motorsport)]
*[[2025 IIHF World Championship]]
**In [[ice hockey]], the [[United States men's national ice hockey team|United States men's national team]] defeats [[Switzerland men's national ice hockey team|Switzerland]] 1–0 in [[overtime (sports)|overtime]] in the [[2025 IIHF World Championship final|final]] to win their first World Men's Championship [[Ice hockey at the 1960 Winter Olympics|since 1960]]. [https://www.nhl.com/news/united-states-wins-gold-at-2025-iihf-world-championship (NHL)]
